facts.fact: Starlink has failed to secure a licence in South Africa because of the 30% historically-disadvantaged equity rule; SpaceX has yet to formally apply for one, per Reuters/TechCentral.
Icasa has cracked down on South Africans using Starlink via grey-market imports and roaming, with inspection teams and warnings against buying unauthorised equipment.

note: Reuters/TechCentral version of the Namibia story.
